title: One line of the wagon master's train state (train.jsonl)
description: A change of a wagon train (hal2 plan 0294 step 6; scripts/train_state.py): `slot` is the carrier's field, on an `unhitched` line the field whose ready mark went (`yard`: the yard's car, step 8).

cars.description: A formed line: the cars in the order they are merged, each an object with field, branch, head and plan; a landed line: their fields.

base.description: The carrier's head before the cars were merged.

status.description: A red line: the landing's result (`gate_failed`, `conflict`, `error`, ...).

commit.description: A landed line: the commit on the default branch; a yard line: the yard's commit in the carrier's field; a regenerated line: the train's last commit, which wrote the generated files again.

files.description: A yard line: the yard's files that ride as the train's first car, each an object with path and hash (the hash of what was carried; none for a deletion). An unhitched line of the slot `yard`: the files that stay out until they change. A regenerated line: the paths of the generated files written again (plan 0313 step 8).

yard.description: A landed line of a train the yard rode: what was done in the yard afterwards: dropped (paths), kept (path and why), pulled, why.

pushed.description: A cleared line: what became of the carrier's remote branch, which the dead train's landing had pushed (put back on the base with a leased push, or why not; plan 0313); none when there was nothing to push.
